name: HTTP Archive (HAR) Importer
description: Import HTTP Archive (.har) files and automatically convert captured browser network requests into native Voiden request files with full support for headers, cookies, query parameters, request bodies, and optional static asset filtering.
author: Voiden Team
readme: Import HTTP Archive (.har) files and automatically convert them into native Voiden .void request files. Supports headers, cookies, query parameters, request bodies (JSON, XML, Form Data, Multipart, Text), folder/page grouping, and static asset filtering.

buttons.description: Opens file picker to select and import HTTP Archive (.har) JSON files

ui.description: Adds import button for HAR files

fileSystem.description: Creates folder structure and .void files from HAR network capture

dependencies.reason: Uses voiden-rest-api helpers to generate compatible REST API blocks

integration.description: Depends on voiden-rest-api extension for REST block generation

features: Import HTTP Archive (.har) JSON files captured from browser Developer Tools
Automatically create folder structure matching page titles or domain hostnames
Convert each HTTP request entry into a native .void file
Preserve request headers and convert to headers-table blocks
Preserve cookies and merge into headers or auth details
Extract query parameters and convert to query-table blocks
Support for all HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS, HEAD, etc.)
Import JSON request bodies and convert to json_body blocks
Import XML request bodies and convert to xml_body blocks
Import form-data bodies and convert to multipart-table blocks
Import URL-encoded bodies and convert to urlencoded-table blocks
Optional static asset filtering (ignore images, stylesheets, scripts, fonts)
Sanitize file and folder names for filesystem compatibility
Progress tracking and cancel support during import
Batch file creation with throttling to prevent system overload
Uses voiden-rest-api helpers for consistent block generation
